description.value: The Dixon Entrance Maritime Museum in Masset, Haida Gwaii, is dedicated to the maritime history of the Dixon Entrance — the international strait separating Haida Gwaii from Alaska. It occupies a dedicated building on Harrison Avenue in one of the most remote cycling destinations in British Columbia. Cyclists who make it to the north end of Haida Gwaii would find this a fitting stop to absorb the seafaring heritage of the region.
